title: C1 Advanced Vocabulary: PERSONALITY (Friendly → Affable)
description:
C1 advanced vocabulary for personality: 40 advanced English words to describe people, each one next to the plain word you already use.
C1 advanced vocabulary is easier to remember when you start from a word you know: you say friendly, shy, rude, lazy, stubborn, honest, too proud or kind, and for each one you get five advanced words, the difference between them and an example sentence.

After every five words you test yourself with two quick questions and practise speaking by repeating the example sentences out loud. The video ends with a final test on all eight parts.

0:13 Instead of "friendly"
1:42 Speaking practice: friendly
2:18 Instead of "shy"

4:11 Instead of "rude"

12:08 Instead of "too proud"

13:54 Instead of "kind"
15:16 Speaking practice: kind
15:47 Final test

The 40 words
Instead of friendly: affable, amiable, gregarious, genial, approachable
Instead of shy: diffident, introverted, timid, reticent, self-effacing
Instead of rude: abrupt, blunt, tactless, condescending, obnoxious
Instead of lazy: idle, indolent, lethargic, complacent, apathetic
Instead of stubborn: strong-willed, headstrong, obstinate, inflexible, tenacious
Instead of honest: frank, candid, forthright, upfront, principled
Instead of too proud: conceited, vain, smug, pompous, haughty
Instead of kind: considerate, compassionate, empathetic, selfless, altruistic

Which word describes you? Write it in the comments.
